race.description: Congrats To 2025-26 Lvtc Winning Premiership Jockey - Brendan Lerena (Bm58) Hcp
race.comment: SCARTOON (9) also resumes, now with Alyssa & Troy Sweeney, and is better judged on her two runs in the middle of last prep. If she returns in similar form she will be right there at the business end. SPIKED (8) is another resuming that has trialled well. Mixed her form last campaign but had strong efforts in there. Not underestimating. TARA'S REWARD (2) is race fit and comes through a Warwick win. No tougher this time so he can win again. I AM A WINNER (4) was unlucky not to return a winner last time but with added fitness second-up he can go one better. Inside alley should see him land cosy and get a good look.
